core.label: Core Rig & Voxel Bodies
core.description: Canonical 53-joint Quaternius UAL1 rig, 43 CC0 clips, and Teardown-style rigid-segment voxel bodies, sculpted voxel heads, and layered voxel hairstyles.

heist.label: Heist & Demolition
heist.description: Urban demolitionists, open jackets with scarves, belted tunics, tattoo vests, backpacks, sledgehammers, detonators, crowbars, and rubble props.

industrial.label: Workshop & Industrial
industrial.description: Weathered work shirts, waist packs, work gloves, cargo pants, knit beanies, hard hats, pipe wrenches, blowtorches, drums, and crates.

security.label: Security & Cyber-Tech
security.description: Collared guard uniforms, utility belts, knee-pad trousers, peaked caps, cyber-tech strap vests, riot helmets, pistols, and security terminals.

creatures.label: Voxel Beasts & Bots
creatures.description: Teardown-style voxel guard hounds on a 23-joint quadruped rig, scrapyard spiders on a 28-joint arachnid rig, and heavy industrial scrap-bots.
